text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ruka was still bewildered, having acknowledged that her feelings for {0} were those of love for a man. However, she couldn't leave her newfounded "Gang" alone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}を一人の男として慕う気持ちを認め、
未だ困惑の中にあるルカ。
しかし『会』の方も放っておくわけにはいかず──

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Our income...?
text_block_list.orig_text: シノギを……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. Even if you started this "Boss Lady Gang", without a stable income, you're just going to end up becoming a gathering for social misfits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああそうだよ。
姉御会なんて発足させたところで、
シノギがなきゃ
ただの社会不適合者の吹き溜まりじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's why I decided to teach you guys how to fish. See this as a vocational training. You'll learn the skills by hand and earn money with those same hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからアンタらに、
釣りを教えることにした。
職業訓練だよ。
しっかり技能を身に付けて、
自分たちの手で稼ぎな！

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: A-ALL RIIIGHT!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
押ーーーー忍っ！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ............So. Why... did you end up here again, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
………………で。
だ。
なんで
お前さんが
今日もここにいる。

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Y'see. It's been a while and Lil'bro did say he was interested in coming to fish and all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへ……
いやね。
聞けばアニキも
久々に釣りがしたいなー
なんて言うもんで……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You guys...
text_block_list.orig_text: アンタら……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: They've been calling for him at every chance they get... Ever since that day, they've self convinced themselves I want to make {0} my "Boss Man"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ことあるごとにこの子を呼びつけて……
あれ以来、
すっかり
アタシの
「いい人」だと
思い込んでるね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Geez, they're all very single-minded usually, but they have a strange eye for those sorts of things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
揃いも揃って単細胞なくせに、
妙な目端だけは利くんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...True enough. This young man... I truly do love him as a man. I acknowledge that. I've accepted it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……確かに。
アタシは
この子を一人の男として慕ってる。
認める。
認めたよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: However, that's merely my one sided feelings at work... Whether there's a special bond between me and this young man is another matter entirely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど
それはアタシの一方的な、
アレで……
アタシとこの子の間に
特別な縁があるかは、
また別問題なんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Or rather, in the first place. There's no way a dangerous woman like me could have a fateful encounter with him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
というかそもそも。
こんな物騒な女との間に
縁なんてあっちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Ah... No! I'm not mad or anything like that. You too... can join us if you want. Come on, guys, let's start fishing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
いや！　
怒ってなんかないよ。
お前さんも……
参加したけりゃ
すりゃいいさ。
──さぁ、
アンタたち、
釣りを始めるよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. How I feel is one thing, what's going on is another. It'd be a problem to him if we had a special bond. So I'll try to be as level-headed as possible with him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうさ。
アタシの気持ちは、
それはそれ。
特別な縁なんて
あっちゃ、
困るんだ。
だからこの子とは、
なるべく
フラットに接する。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ....That's just fine. Yeah. I'll settle this matter like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それでいいんだ。
うん。
この話は、
これまで。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I borrowed a fishing rod for everyone. Each of you can choose a fishing rod from here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人数分釣り竿を借りてきたから。
各自、
ここから釣り竿を選んで。

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT!
text_block_list.orig_text: 押忍！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Okay. Then... as for me, this one will...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし。
じゃあ、
アタシは
この竿で……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Hah! L-{0}, you too?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
──はっ！　
お前さんも！？

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey... Out of all these options, you two chose the same rod?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい……
こんなに数ある中から、
お二人さん、
同じ竿を選んだってのか？

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: Isn't that one amazing coincidence? I knew it, Lil'bro truly is Boss Lady's choice for a "Boss Man"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すげぇ偶然じゃねぇか？
やっぱりアニキは、
姉御のいい人──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I-I already told you I'm not trying to make him my "Boss Man" or anything like that! It's just a coincidence. Don't make a fuss about every little thing. Let's start!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい人でもなんでもないって言ってんだろ！
ただの偶然だよ。
いちいち騒ぎ立てるんじゃない。
始めるよ！

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: A-......ALL RIGHT!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お……
押忍っ！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Geez. Just as I thought I had sorted out my feelings...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく。
人が気持ちを整理したそばから……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Understand? This is the length of the rig. It's not always better to have a longer length.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいかい？　
仕掛けの垂らしは
このくらい。
長ければいいってもんじゃないからね。

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Umm... Will this do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと……
こうか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Everyone, are you ready? Now, next up, as if you were trying to throw a ball far away... try to draw a parabola... with your rod!
text_block_list.orig_text:
各自構えたね？
じゃあ次は、
ボールを遠くへ投げるように……
竿で、
放物線を……
描く！

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: ...WE'LL DRAW IT!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……描く！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: All right, it seems you've all done a good job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
みんなうまく投げられたね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, h-huh? My thread is... connected to something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……て、
あ、
あれ？
アタシの糸が……
何かと絡んでる？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: E-EEEEHHHH?! Our threads have intertwined in midair?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ！？
糸同士が、
空中で絡んだってのかい！？

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: In such a huge beach with so many fishermen all trying to cast their rods. What a terrifying coincidence... You two truly are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんだけ広い浜で、
こんだけ釣り人がいて。
これまた、
恐ろしい偶然じゃねぇか……
お二人さん……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: "Us two" are nothing! Stop making a fuss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お二人さんって言うな。
騒ぐなっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second, {0}. I'll untangle this right away... Ugh, they're completely intertwined.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お前さん
ちょいと待ってな。
今、
解くから……
くっ、
完全に絡み合っちまってるね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'd be helpful. ...B-But, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
助かるよ。
……だ、
だけど、
ええと……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: {0}... I'm sorry, but could you... let go of my body, if only a little?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん……
悪いが、
もうちょいと、
体を……
離して
くれないかい。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Aaah, geez. Why do coincidences like these have to happen at times like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああもうっ。
こういう時に限って、
なんで
こんな偶然が重なる──

text_block_list.name: Underling 3
text_block_list.text: Did you just see that? What Boss Lady called a "coincidence". I know Boss Lady said as much, but I truly believe that those two share an extraordinary bond...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見たかよ今の偶然。
姉御はああ言うが、
やっぱり二人の間には
ただならぬ縁が──

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: Shh! Boss Lady will get mad at us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しっ！
姉御が怒る。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: These guys... Hm? Wait a sec. Could this possibly be--
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつら……
……うん？　
待ちなよ。
これ、
ひょっとして──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see. So that's how it is. Heh, that makes sense. You guys, get back here at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
そうか。
そういうことかい。
ふっ、
合点がいったよ。
アンタたち、
ここに直りな！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: B-Boss Lady? What's going on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
姉御？　
いったいどうしたんで？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Still planning on playing dumb I see. All those "coincidences"... they're all your doing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しらばっくれやがって。
どれもこれも、
アンタたちの仕業だろうが！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: The fact that I and this young man chose the same rod, and that our fishing lines got tangled. Those are all part of your plan to make it seem like I'm trying to make him my "Boss Man", that's what I'm saying!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシとこの子が
同じ竿を選んだのも、
釣り糸が絡んだのも。
偶然を装って
この子をアタシの「いい人」に仕立て上げたい、
アンタたちの膳立てだろうって言ってんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Geez, you don't even have a stable income, yet you're worrying about spreading such unnecessary "wisdom".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
シノギもないくせに、
余計な知恵ばかり回しやがって。

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: N-No, no! We didn't do anyth--
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いやいや！
ワシら、
なんも──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see. Then I'll be trying your hands up so you're unable to do anything unnecessary again. All of you, practice swinging your rods right now... 10,000 times!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
そうかい。
じゃあ金輪際
余計なことができないよう、
アンタらの手を塞いでやる。
全員、
今から竿の素振り、
１万回だ！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Huh...? T-TEN THOUSAND?!

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: A-ALL RIGHT!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
押忍！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Geez. I'm sorry for getting you involved in their antics, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく。
お前さん、
巻き込んじまって悪かったね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You joined us because you just wanted to fish in peace, didn't you? And yet this place has turned into quite a mess... Just drop your line slowly in a separate spot over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
普通に釣りがしたくて、
参加してくれたんだろう？
ここは
なんだかんだでゴチャついてるから。
向こうの離れた場所で、
ゆっくり糸、
垂らしときなよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I've already taught you the basics of fishing before, {0}. I have nothing to further teach you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんには
もう釣りのイロハは教えてあるだろう。
アタシから伝授することなんて、
ひとつもないよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Honestly speaking, you're in the way. ...Stay away from me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
正直、
邪魔なんだ。
……離れてておくれよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Alright then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──
さぁ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You guys! I'll show you how to reel it in. First, let's learn how to make the float swim. Don't stop practicing, and show me how badly you do it so you can learn from your mistakes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタたち！　
釣り上げるまでの手本を見せるよ。
まずは浮きの泳がせ方から。
素振りの手を休めず、
その節穴
かっぴらいて見てな！

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: A-AAAALLL RIIIIGHT!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
押ーーーー
忍！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That young man... he's moved so far away from us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子……
ちゃんと
離れた場所に
移動したね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: This is for the best. A relationship that requires things to be set up artificially in advance is no real relationship at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでよかったんだよ。
膳立てしてもらわなきゃいけない縁なんて、
縁でもなんでもないからね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: By blocking all kinds of manipulations, there's no way such "coincidences" can happen now. In the first place, thanks to those guys unnecessary meddling, things have become clearer now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして作為を封じちまえば、
偶然なんて起こる道理がない。
アイツらの余計な膳立てのお陰で、
むしろ
白黒がはっきりしたよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Or rather, it was a good thing. I feel refreshed now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……逆に、
よかったんだ。
すっきりしたってもんさ。

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady, Boss Lady! Your float's moving! Did you get a bite?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御、
姉御！
浮きが動いてますぜ！
アタリがきてるんじゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! You're right. This is a big one! You guys, watch closely!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！　
ほんとだね。
これは大物だよ！
アンタたち、
よーく見ときな！

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT!
text_block_list.orig_text: 押忍！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: First... set the hook. Then... pull it up... and take it in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは……
アワセる。
そして……
ズリ上げて……
取り込む！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Huh? Someone else is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？　
あれ？
取り込──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ruka's Underlings
text_block_list.text: EEEEEHHHH?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えええ！？

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: It seems unbelievable to hear, but... it's true. This fish swallowed two fishing hooks at once, one from Boss Lady and the other from Lil'bro!
text_block_list.orig_text:
信じられんが……
ほんとだ。
この魚、
姉御のとアニキのと、
いっぺんに二つの釣り針を飲みこんでる！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: I didn't know... such a thing could happen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなことが……
あるのか……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Y-You guys... haven't you learned your lesson yet---
text_block_list.orig_text:
ア、
アンタら
また性懲りもなく──

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: No, no! All of us... we were practicing those ten thousand swings just like Boss Lady told us to! We didn't do anything, or rather, we couldn't do anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや！
ワシら全員、
姉御の指示通り素振り１万回中でしたから！
なんにもしてない、
つーか
できないですよ！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: As you can see, all of us are HELD UP!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この通り、
全員、
ほーるどあっぷです！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Then, from the beginning, you did nothing...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
最初から、
何も……？

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: We didn't!
text_block_list.orig_text: してません！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess we invited Lil'bro here to fish. We're sorry on that, we were just trying to be considerate. But that's really all there is to it. We swear on our honor, please believe us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
釣りに
アニキは誘いました。
それは、
すんません、
気遣いです。
でも
本当にそれだけなんです。
ワシらの
このハラワタにかけて、
信じてくだせぇ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: So that means... That thing about the fishing rod and the fishing line... were really just coincidences?
text_block_list.orig_text:
て、
ことは……
釣り竿の件も、
釣り糸の件も……
本当の、
偶然だってのかい？

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, yes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
です、
ですです！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: A single fish swallowing two hooks... No matter how you look at it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
一匹の魚が
二つの針を飲むなんて……
いくらなんでも……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: There's no way such a coincidence could happen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな偶然
あるわけが……

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Boss Lady's completely right... There's no way such a coincidence could happen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
姉御の言う通りですわ……
こんな偶然、
あるわけがねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: This isn't a coincidence at all... No matter how you look at it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなの偶然じゃねぇ……
どっからどう見ても……

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: ...It's fate...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……運命っすよ……

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Lil'bro and Boss Lady... you said you don't have any... special connection... And yet how could... this happen between you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アニキと姉御の間に……
なんの……
特別な縁もねぇなんて……
そんなこと……
どーやってこのハラに落としゃいいんですか……

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: If there really is nothing between you two... Boss Lady, tell us the truth here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に二人の間に何もないというなら……
姉御。
ワシらに、
教えてくだせぇよ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ............Such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I'd actually love to know myself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシだって
知りたいよ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ruka had no choice but to acknowledge the extraordinary bond between her and {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}との間の
ただならぬ縁までもを認めざるを得ないルカ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Standing before the two fishing rods connected by a single fish, she couldn't contain her rising excitement anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一匹の魚でつながってしまった二本の釣り竿を前に、
今度こそ高まる思いを、抑えきれないのであった。
